title: Sherpa voice ASR UI validation: Qwen3-ASR (raokouling)
description: Drives the /features/asr screen end-to-end with the Qwen3-ASR 0.6B int8 model and the bundled `raokouling.wav` Mandarin sample, asserting the transcript displayed in the UI is non-empty. Requires the Qwen3 model to be downloaded on the target device. KNOWN FLAKY: Qwen3 lands at the bottom of the model picker FlatList; `findFiberByTestId` + `press` cannot reliably reach off-screen virtualized rows. Use `asr-qwen3-roundtrip` (bridge-level) for stable validation until the recipe runner gains a scroll-to-testID-visible primitive.
